title: A Char-MLP Language Model, Step by Step
tagline: Walk one forward-and-backward pass of a tiny character-level MLP, one Step at a time
summary: A makemore-style char-MLP stripped to its bones: 8-character vocab, a 3-character context, 2-D embeddings, one tanh hidden layer. Press Step to advance a single training example through embed, concatenate, hidden layer, softmax, cross-entropy loss, and backprop — every number drawn live on the canvas with fixed, reproducible weights. The finale makes next-token learning concrete: the gradient p - y flows back and edits only the two embedding rows the example actually used.
highlights: Step through one full forward-and-backward pass of a tiny char-level MLP, stage by stage, with live numbers.
See the pipeline explicitly: embed → concatenate → tanh hidden layer → softmax → cross-entropy → backprop.
Watch the context 'v, e, e' (from the name Naveen) light up exactly two rows of the embedding table — 'e' is used twice and its gradient accumulates.
Read the softmax as a bar chart, mark the true next character 'n', and see the loss -log p_true as one big number.
The punchline of next-token prediction: the gradient p - y updates only the embedding rows that were looked up; every other row gets exactly zero.
